about: How stage 0 sorts a difference in model_config.json between an audio model and its nearest model. serving: a setting that only chooses how the model is run (the maximum length, the default sampler); the weights and the network are the same. structural: a key that shapes the network, the audio format or the conditioning. unknown: every key not listed. Only `serving` differences can leave the path weights-only. The same table is copied into delta_triage.py (AUDIO_CATEGORY_RULES); tests/test_audio_class_inference.py fails when the two differ. Sources are the library commit named in each rule, read on 2026-10-28.
